item_short_desc: Rothco’s 5 Panel Rip-Stop Street Cap offers a stylish and practical accessory for everyday wear. Made with 100% cotton rip-stop fabric, this cap provides enhanced durability and resistance to tearing, ensuring long-lasting performance. Its 5-panel construction gives the cap a structured, classic appearance, while dual side vents provide essential airflow to keep you cool during outdoor activities. The cap also features a plastic buckle closure that allows for easy adjustments, ensuring a secure and comfortable fit.
